version_tag: #167 SLEEVE REV C, SOLO — RETRACTION of rev B (plate-51), which is scrap. Ron, bench, with the drive drum against the new fixture: 'Things are not lining up.' Measured: rev B's flange (bore r4.17) cannot swallow the drive post's COLLAR (r6.5, platform 4.0 up to exactly 5.0, present since fixture r58) — the flange lands ON the collar, seating the stack at 7.5 instead of 5.0. Every arm +2.5mm: 24h half-engaged on the board, 23h striking the empty gap between month tips (11.7-12.5) and feb mesh (16.0+), 22h/21h missing outright, and the 24h band grazing the month satellite's mesh lamina by ~0.2mm. The collar top IS the axial seat the #149 stack was designed around: the bottom piece's 11.50 square bore cannot pass the 13.0 collar. #159's 'no z-datum' premise is retracted; the June low-stack observation is reopened. Rev C = straight keyed tube, 25.0 long, bottom face on the collar at 5.0, top flush with the 21h piece at 30.0. NEW GATE (the one #159 lacked): seated-stack acceptance measures the collar off the fixture STL and every arm band cumulatively off the piece STLs — all four land on their strike targets within 0.05. 10 gates PASS incl. rev B's measured condemnation. Assembly: pull rev B sleeve, drop rev C over the post, restack the four pieces; bottom piece and sleeve both seat on the collar. | QUIET.
